dedupe_keys.name: modecom 2024 ademe national composition of french household residual waste separate collections and recycling centre waste

description: MODECOM is France's national method and campaign for measuring what household waste is made of, and the 2024 campaign gives the current breakdown of what French households throw away in residual bins, separate collections and recycling centres. It is run and published by ADEME, the French agency for ecological transition, from its national MODECOM sorting campaign. The ten tables give, for each waste sub-category, the mass share, national tonnage and kilograms per inhabitant per year with 95 percent confidence intervals, detailed composition by particle size for residual waste, packaging and paper and glass collections, the composition of waste brought to recycling centres, moisture content of residual waste and the sorting grids used. The tables are free and available to download in CSV or through the ADEME API under the Licence Ouverte. Caveats: results are national averages from one campaign, with no breakdown by municipality or collection scheme, and categories follow the MODECOM sorting grid, which must be read with the tables. Simulation uses: setting waste stream composition for collection, sorting and treatment models, estimating recoverable materials and energy content, and calibrating recycling scenarios. Related records: the NYC waste characterisation (data-dsny-waste-characterization) and CalRecycle waste characterisation (data-calrecycle-waste-characterization) are comparable composition studies.
name: MODECOM 2024 (ADEME): national composition of French household residual waste, separate collections and recycling centre waste
schema_summary: Ten MODECOM 2024 tables: composition of residual household waste (OMR) and separate collections (CS) as mass percentage, tonnage and kg per inhabitant per year by sub-category with 95% confidence half-intervals; detailed composition by particle size for OMR, packaging and paper (CSM) and glass (CSB); composition and groupings for recycling centres (déchèteries); moisture content of OMR; sorting grids
